text: Pune Breaking News: Stampede-Like Situation At Shivneri Fort During Shivaji Jayanti CelebrationsA stampede-like situation was reported at Shivneri Fort during Shivaji Jayanti celebrations following a midnight rush that triggered panic among the crowd. Several devotees, including women and children, sustained injuries. The injured have been shifted to a nearby hospital for treatment.
